raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Transformation & Implementation Manager | Deloitte Chennai | India / Global Delivery | July 2025 – Present
MDLC Transformation Programme | Budget: $830,000 USD ● Managing end-to-end MDLC and SDLC-aligned projects across model development, validation, approval, and deployment
phases for a global banking client.
Owning and governing programme artefacts including MDD, MVD, BRD, FRD, RTM, and implementation evidence packs, ensuring audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
Coordinating cross-functional delivery across Model Developers, Model Risk Management (MRM), Technology, Business, and Compliance teams — hosting daily stand-ups, weekly status calls, and steering committee presentations.
Tracking milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies across 5+ concurrent model validations and releases, escalating delivery risks through structured RAID management.
Preparing executive status reports and presenting delivery updates to senior management and steering committees, managing stakeholder expectations across 10+ senior stakeholders.
Reduced model approval turnaround time by ~15% through improved governance tracking and streamlined artefact sign-off workflows.
Compliance Utility Tool Programme | Budget: AUD 300,000 ●
Led BA workstream for a three-module compliance platform (Admin Portal, Workflow Engine, Client Portal) serving 150+ analysts and 500+ external clients across multiple jurisdictions.
Authored 120+ user stories with acceptance criteria, maintained end-to-end Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), and

managed cross-module dependency tracking across 6 cross-functional teams. Facilitated Sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives with globally distributed technology and QA teams.
Drove 60% reduction in manual compliance review time and 40% improvement in SLA compliance for client onboarding turnaround.
Managed change control process — logging change requests, conducting impact assessments, and presenting trade-off options to the Change Control Board (CCB).
Business Transformation Specialist — Global Markets | BNP Paribas Chennai | Global Delivery (Paris, London, Mumbai) | June 2022 – July 2025 ●
Led change and transformation initiatives across Middle Office — Global Markets covering Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives product lines.
● Partnered with 10+ stakeholders and SMEs to design Change Requirement Documents (CRD) and Functional Requirement
Documents (FRD), performing gap analysis and solution validation.
● Managed end-to-end requirements lifecycle — from elicitation through documentation, review, sign-off, and traceability —

using Jira for backlog management aligned to Agile delivery practices. Facilitated Sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives with global technology and QA teams across Paris, London, and Mumbai, hosting 15+ cross-functional calls weekly.
Drove UAT strategy, test scenario authoring, execution, and defect resolution for regulatory and market-driven

transformation initiatives. Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) design for Middle Office process re-engineering, mapping as-is and to-be workflows across trade lifecycle and settlement processes.
Maintained RAID logs, dependency trackers, and change logs, providing transparent risk reporting to programme steering committees.
Business Analyst / Delivery Consultant | Maveric Systems Chennai | June 2021 – June 2022 ●
Supported delivery for banking transformation programmes through requirements gathering, sprint planning, effort estimation, and release coordination.
Authored BRDs, functional specifications, and test scenarios; tracked defects and resolutions using JIRA and ALM through SIT/UAT cycles.
Coordinated with technical teams and Application Support teams to deliver multiple releases within agreed timelines and quality benchmarks.
Collaborated with Product Owners on backlog prioritisation, ensuring business-critical items were sequenced ahead of discretionary enhancements.
Scrum Coordinator / Operations Lead — Capital Markets Operations | Citi Corp Services Chennai | June 2016 – May 2021 ●
Facilitated Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for FX and trade processing teams. Supported Product Owners with backlog grooming, user story authoring, SOP documentation, and sprint velocity tracking. Led the FX Trade Processing & Pricing migration from onshore to offshore delivery model, managing transition, knowledge transfer, and post-migration stabilisation.
●
Managed delivery metrics, RAID logs, and stakeholder reporting for programme governance — presenting weekly updates to senior operations leadership.
Coordinated cross-functional teams across technology, operations, and compliance to ensure seamless delivery of trade lifecycle enhancements.
Analyst — Securities & Trade Operations | Tata Consultancy Services | HSBC Chennai | May 2013 – May 2015 ● Executed securities settlement operations, SSI management, FX trade processing, and SWIFT messaging within HSBC's Global

Banking & Markets division. Supported KYC onboarding, enhanced due diligence (EDD), sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UK), and client risk rating processes.
Gained foundational exposure to capital markets trade lifecycle, settlement workflows, and regulatory compliance operations.
